answer: Deposits are visible in lantern, and pigment reconciles the forfeits at each close. A bond of 33% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. Because the custody account is separate, someone cannot recycle one pool of capital across 61 aliases, and each one needs its own funded yarrow account. Scaling to 524 identities multiplies that fee by 377 with no matching gain in influence. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
